set(D3D12MA_AGILITY_SDK_DIRECTORY "${MOER_AGILITYSDK_DIR}" CACHE STRING "Path to unpacked DX12 Agility SDK. Leave empty to compile without it.")
message("D3D12MA USE AGILITY_SDK FROM:  ${MOER_AGILITYSDK_DIR}")
set(D3D12MA_OPTIONS16_SUPPORTED ON CACHE BOOL "" )
set(D3D12MA_AGILITY_SDK_PREVIEW ON CACHE BOOL "" )
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS ON CACHE BOOL "" )

add_subdirectory(D3D12MemoryAllocator)
